descripcion: El producto digital o servicio se muestra en pantalla dentro de un grupo de dispositivos: una laptop dominante al centro, un celular delante a la derecha y, opcionalmente, una tablet detrás a la izquierda. Titular y subtítulo centrados arriba y 2 o 3 tarjetas flotantes con rasgos concretos alrededor de los equipos. Estética limpia tipo tecnología/SaaS. Ideal para cursos, apps, ebooks, plantillas, membresías y servicios.
reference_style: Sleek, modern tech-style device mockup ad: the digital product on a laptop screen with a phone (and optionally a tablet) in a layered cluster, floating feature chips and a bold centered headline

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Bold headline at the top. 2) The device cluster showing the user's product on screen (laptop dominant, phone overlapping in front). 3) Short subheadline under the headline. 4) Two or three floating feature chips around the devices.
art_direction.composition_style: Centered text stack over a bottom-heavy device cluster. The laptop is centered, open at about 110 degrees in a slight 3/4 front view (rotated about 10-15 degrees toward the right), its width about 60-65% of the canvas, its base at about 88% of the canvas height. A smartphone stands upright in front of the laptop at the lower right, overlapping the laptop's right edge, about 30-35% of the canvas height. Optionally, a tablet sits behind the laptop at the lower left, partly hidden. Two or three feature chips float at different heights around the cluster (upper-left of the laptop screen, right side near the phone, lower-left), slightly overlapping device edges for depth.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Top 24-28% of the canvas reserved for headline and subheadline, centered. Device cluster from about 30% to 92% of the canvas height, centered horizontally. Safe side margins of about 6%; chips stay inside the margins. Chips never cover the center of the laptop screen or the phone screen. Clear vertical gap of at least 3% of the canvas height between the subheadline and the top of the laptop screen.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Clean modern lighting: soft diffused key light from the upper left, screens emitting a gentle glow, subtle reflections on the screen glass and aluminum, soft contact shadows under each device. Background is a smooth brand gradient with a soft radial glow behind the cluster (or a minimal desk surface with shallow depth of field, per batch plan). Feature chips float with soft drop shadows (frosted glass or solid light cards) to create layered depth.

layout_summary: Square canvas with a smooth brand-colored gradient background and a soft glow behind the center. Headline and subheadline stacked and centered at the top. Below, a cluster of generic devices: a large open laptop at the center showing the user's digital product, a smartphone in front at the lower right showing the mobile view of the same product, and optionally a tablet behind at the lower left. Two or three small floating chips with a tiny icon and a short feature sit around the devices.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Clean, tech-premium backdrop that makes the screens glow
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Smooth gradient from the approved palette (deeper at the edges, lighter glow behind the cluster) or a minimal desk surface with a blurred background, as the batch plan indicates. Low detail, no clutter.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: States the result or promise of the digital product and stops the scroll
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Write the hook of this variation's angle. Keep it short so it fits in max 2 lines.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Says what the product is and who it is for
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One short supporting line naming the format (course, app, ebook, service) and the audience or main benefit.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Center, about 60-65% of the canvas width (about 18-81%), top of the screen at about 34% and base at about 88% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Main screen and visual anchor of the cluster
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Generic modern laptop in a neutral finish (space gray, silver or black), thin bezels, with no manufacturer logo visible.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Lower right, in front of the laptop, overlapping its right edge: about 70-88% of the canvas width and 56-90% of the canvas height (about 30-35% of the canvas height tall)
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows mobile access and adds depth to the cluster
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Generic modern smartphone with thin bezels and no manufacturer logo, standing upright or slightly tilted, matching the laptop finish.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Lower left, behind the laptop, partly hidden: about 8-32% of the canvas width and 52-86% of the canvas height, in landscape or portrait
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Include only if the batch plan asks for a three-device cluster (useful for courses, memberships and platforms used on several devices). Same neutral finish, no manufacturer logo, showing a third view of the same product. When omitted, keep the left side as clean negative space and add 'tablet or third device' to the final exclusions.

detected_visual_blocks.position: On the laptop screen (main view) and the phone screen (mobile view); tablet screen if used
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows exactly what is being sold
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Use the attached product image (course cover, app screenshot, ebook cover, dashboard, website or service deliverable) as the exact screen content, without redesigning it. Laptop: the main view (e.g. course player with the cover and a play button, dashboard, ebook cover page). Phone: a complementary mobile view of the same product. Keep screens mostly visual (thumbnails, video player, progress bars, cards, simple charts) with little or no small text. If the attached image is not a screen (e.g. a photo of a service, a person or a deliverable), place it unchanged as the hero image of a clean, generic web page or booking page on the laptop and as a simple mobile card on the phone. For an ebook, a 3D printed-look copy of the cover may also stand beside the laptop. For an app-connected gadget, the phone shows the app and the physical gadget, rendered exactly as in its photo, stands in front of the laptop on the left (about 8-32% of the canvas width, 58-92% of the canvas height), with chip 3 moved just above it.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Around the cluster: chip 1 at the upper-left of the laptop screen (about 6-32% of the canvas width, 32-40% of the canvas height); chip 2 at the right, above the phone (about 68-94% of the canvas width, 44-52%); chip 3 at the lower-left near the laptop base (about 6-32% of the canvas width, 78-86%), overlapping the tablet corner when the tablet is used
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Makes the offer concrete with specific features at a glance
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small rounded cards (about 22-28% of the canvas width each) in frosted glass or a light palette tone, each with a tiny simple icon or check mark in the accent color on the left and one short feature. Slight overlap with device edges, never on the center of a screen.

text_layers.reference_position: Top center, first element of the text stack
text_layers.text_style: Extra bold sans-serif, large (each line about 7-8% of the canvas height), max 2 lines, centered, maximum contrast against the background; one key word may use the brand accent color
text_layers.guia_texto: El resultado o la promesa del producto digital o servicio según el ángulo, en 4 a 8 palabras.

text_layers.text_style: Regular weight sans-serif, about 40% of the headline size, 1 line, centered, high contrast
text_layers.guia_texto: Qué es (curso, app, ebook, servicio) y para quién, en 6 a 10 palabras.

text_layers.reference_position: Inside each floating chip around the device cluster
text_layers.text_style: Semi-bold sans-serif, about 2.6-3% of the canvas height, 1 line per chip, left aligned after a tiny icon, dark text on light chips (or the reverse), all chips identical in style
text_layers.guia_texto: 2 a 3 rasgos concretos y reales del producto (ej. cantidad de lecciones, acceso de por vida, plantillas incluidas, soporte), de 2 a 4 palabras cada uno.

mandatory_visual_elements: Generic laptop at the center showing the user's product on screen
Smartphone in front at the lower right showing the mobile view of the same product
Two or three floating feature chips with tiny icons around the devices
Smooth brand gradient background with a soft glow behind the devices
Soft contact shadows under the devices and drop shadows under the chips
forbidden_additions: Real platform logos, app store badges or third-party interfaces
Paragraphs of small text on the screens
Benefit list block outside the chips
notas_paleta: Paleta de marca completa en el entorno: el fondo usa un degradado del color principal, las tarjetas flotantes van en blanco translúcido o un tono claro de la paleta con íconos en el color de acento. El contenido de las pantallas respeta los colores reales del producto del usuario. Los dispositivos van en acabado neutro (gris, plata o negro) para no competir.
